Real paper question (WBPSC Clerkship Part-I 2023, Session II, Q64): 'Who is the famous personality known for his role in the anti-apartheid movement in South Africa?' — answer Nelson Mandela. Taught in week3_skills_mandela: PIB (Films Division) calls Mandela 'the icon of the anti-apartheid movement' (claim c22), with his 27 years of incarceration and the 1994 ANC victory in c23; the section deep text names this very PYQ pattern.
